pool.description: Default NTP server pool to use for time synchronization.

internal_networks.description: List of internal networks to grant limited NTP access (e.g., for LAN time distribution).

stats_logging.description: Enable logging of loop, peer, and clock statistics to files.

leap_seconds_file.description: Path to leap seconds definition file (e.g., '/usr/share/zoneinfo/leap-seconds.list'). Leave null to skip.

settle_threshold.description: Time (in seconds) to wait after startup before allowing time slewing. Use 0 for immediate.

force_ipv4_only.description: Force NTP daemon to use only IPv4. Conflicts with force_ipv6_only.

force_ipv6_only.description: Force NTP daemon to use only IPv6. Conflicts with force_ipv4_only.

broadcast_enabled.description: Enable NTP broadcast mode on a designated subnet. Not recommended in secure environments unless needed for legacy clients.

peers.description: List of explicit peer servers (beyond the main pool), useful for hybrid or high-availability setups.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the peer server.

prefer.description: Mark this peer as preferred (adds 'prefer' keyword to server line).

log_level.description: NTP logging verbosity level: 'info', 'warning', 'error', 'event'. Leave null for default.

enable_keys.description: Enable symmetric key authentication (rarely needed; use only if legacy clients require it).

enable_monitoring_stats.description: Enable runtime monitoring statistics output for external analysis (e.g., NTP monitoring tools).
